common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square pixel-art dungeon texture for an old-school first-person terminal dungeon crawl, ultimately sampled to exactly 32x32 pixels. Create ONE texture that completely fills a square canvas, with an obvious coarse 32 by 32 logical pixel grid, large clean pixel clusters, nearest-neighbor enlarged appearance, crisp hard pixel edges, no subpixel detail, no dithering, no fine noise, no gradients. Flat orthographic texture, no perspective, no surrounding scene, no outer border, no margins, no text. Black-paper aesthetic with muted colors under very dim ambient torchlight. Dark recesses #0b0a08 and #151614, stone planes #322b2b #3d3a36 #515349 #63655c, restrained highlights #7a7c72. Avoid white, hypercontrast, bloom, photographic materials, painterly strokes and decorative frames. Leave enough contrast for the main subject to read at 32x32. Walls must repeat seamlessly horizontally: matching materials, courses and heights at left and right edges, consistent diffuse lighting across the tile. Real light only may use the signal palette. This is a single material tile, not a sprite sheet or a contact sheet.

textures.wall_stone: Primary request: rough dungeon masonry, default Crypt and Mines wall. Front-on. Four broad irregular courses of large, worn rectangular stone blocks, staggered vertical mortar joints, deep charcoal mortar, muted warm-gray faces with two or three broad shading planes per block and a few large chips. Exactly horizontal seamless repeat, no large central focal feature, no objects or light sources.
textures.wall_crypt: Primary request: dungeon masonry with a single burial niche and skull shelf. Front-on. A broad dark rectangular burial niche in the central half of the square, inset in muted warm-gray large stone blocks. Within the recess sit TWO clearly simplified aged gray skulls, each about five logical pixels across, two deep-black eye sockets and one dark nose mark, on a thick chipped stone shelf. The surrounding block courses continue seamlessly across left/right edges. Skulls use restrained #63655c #7a7c72 highlights, no white. Simple bold niche silhouette, no tiny ornamentation.
textures.wall_mine: Primary request: rough dark rock face held up by timber props. Front-on. Broad irregular charcoal rock planes, one thick vertical timber prop near each side and a thick horizontal support beam along the upper part, joined in a simple mine shoring structure. Worn deep brown timbers #331a0c #452712 #582b13 with a few large #684629 marks. Simplified grain, two visible dull gray iron fasteners. Rock and beam heights continue seamlessly across left/right boundaries. No rails, no tools, no perspective.
textures.wall_keep: Primary request: scorched brick wall at Dragon Keep with two thin branching ember cracks. Front-on. Four broad staggered courses of large dark red-brown soot-black bricks, muted planes #25140b #322b2b #452712 #3d3a36, thick shadow joints. Only a few ember pixels in two jagged one-logical-pixel-wide cracks running through the central bricks, deep ember red #a8341f and a tiny warm orange #ecb64a hot spot. Less than three percent of the tile glows, no bloom, no lava lake. Seamless horizontal repeat of brick courses.
textures.wall_archive: Primary request: water-stained bookshelves of the Drowned Archive. Front-on. Two rows of broad old book spines on thick dark brown wooden horizontal shelves. Books form simple 3-to-5 logical-pixel-wide blocks in muted umber #452712 #684629, moss gray-green #35543f #263b1c and slate #22303a #2f4a52. A few broad irregular dark damp patches and pale green water-stain marks across the lower row. Large readable book silhouettes, no lettering, no tiny page detail. Books and shelf boards fill the square edge to edge with seamless horizontal shelf continuity, no outer cabinet frame.
textures.wall_fungal: Primary request: moss-grown dungeon stone with a few softly glowing mushrooms. Front-on. Large charcoal-gray masonry blocks with broad creeping moss patches in #182414 #263b1c #335022 #3f6428. Three clearly shaped small mushrooms in the central lower half, each a chunky rounded cap above a simple short stem. Muted teal #12414f #2079a6 caps with a tiny #50c6b3 pixel underneath only on the brightest mushroom, very subtle actual bioluminescence, no halo or bloom. Dominantly dark stone and moss. Stone courses and moss continue seamlessly horizontally.
textures.wall_unknown: Primary request: an uncanny wall, pale lattice lines over black and one faint eye. Front-on. Mostly near-black #0b0a08 and #151614, crossed by thin coarse angular diagonal lattice strokes of muted #3d3a36 and #63655c, low contrast, irregular yet meeting coherently at left/right edges. Only one small half-open almond-shaped eye in the central region, about 7 logical pixels wide, an extremely faint desaturated teal #12414f slit with a dark pupil. The lattice should feel structurally wrong, no bright neon, no white, no gradients, no extra eyes. Seamless horizontal repeat.
textures.door: Primary request: iron-banded wooden door in a dungeon stone frame. Front-on orthographic. One centered closed rectangular door occupying the central two-thirds of the square, a thick squared chipped charcoal-gray stone jamb and lintel around it. Door is five broad vertical dark brown planks #331a0c #452712 #582b13, two thick horizontal dull-gray iron bands #322b2b #515349, a simple small iron ring latch. Plain medieval shape that is unmistakable at 32x32, no ornate engraving. Surrounding masonry continues consistently across left/right edges. No perspective, no light source.
textures.stairs: Primary request: a wall opening with steps going down into the dark. Front-on tile, orthographic wall plane. A wide centered rectangular opening in large dark gray masonry, heavy squared stone lintel and jambs. In the bottom half of the opening only, five simple stacked horizontal gray step edges recede by becoming darker toward the upper inside, the upper half of the recess is nearly black. Bold staircase cue, no tunnel perspective, no vanishing-point corridor, no decorative arch. Surrounding masonry courses match at left/right edges.
textures.floor_flags: Primary request: old dungeon flagstones viewed directly from above. Seamless square texture repeating BOTH horizontally and vertically. Six to nine broad irregular rectangular flagstones in muted warm gray #322b2b #3d3a36 #515349, thick very dark mortar #151614. Staggered joints, a few coarse chipped corners and one short restrained crack. Stone slabs cross every boundary and match the opposite side. Even diffuse dim light, no central vignette, no light source, no perspective, no pebbles, no noise.
textures.ceiling: Primary request: very dark dungeon vaulting viewed directly from below as a flat repeating material plan. Seamless square texture repeating BOTH horizontally and vertically. Coarse broad almost-black stone panels #0b0a08 #151614 #322b2b, with a simple intersecting diagonal rib lattice in low-contrast charcoal #3d3a36. Suggest heavy ancient vault ribs and deep stone recesses using only 3 to 4 tones, darker than the walls. Diagonal ribs continue exactly across opposite boundaries. No sky, no opening, no eye, no perspective, no glow, no noise.
